(2) Correct GET /v1/config semantics - absent means unavailable, not returned with enabled:false. (3) Remove admin-log-lookup and stale-datasource frontend projections - no identified UI surface. (4) Preserve existing component IDs and Conversation Analytics 400 behavior. (5) Verify all get_tools_by_query callers. (6) Tighten AC by removing blanket criteria. (7) Recalculate complexity after removals.

(2) Preserve aiChampionsLeaderboard ID (no features: prefix), reconcile customer-config vs LEADERBOARD_ENABLED precedence. (3) Complete Smart Tool Selection caller inventory now, not deferred. (4) Resolve ADMIN_LOG_LOOKUP_ENABLED backward-compat rollout strategy. (5) Move Yevhenii's startup fixes and EPMCDME-14657 items out of Ivan's AC into integration-dependencies section. (6) Clarify shared pattern with Yevhenii without coupling retrieval to ES.

Four factual corrections: (1) Document all 3 confirmed get_tools_by_query callers (smart_tool_selector, toolkit_service, validate_tools_node); (2) aiChampionsLeaderboard control is YAML-only, no SettingDeclaration/dynamic DB override; (3) Remove EPMCDME-14643 startup ticket reference — wrong ticket; (4) Explicit integration/config dependency for standalone ADMIN_LOG_LOOKUP_ENABLED=False, ownership TBD.
